audit_items.classification_reason: SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests rollback_transaction functionality from the Ethereum execution layer specification. The target workspace contains Prysm, an Ethereum consensus layer (beacon chain) client written in Go. The execution layer state management functions (rollback_transaction, begin_transaction, etc.) are not implemented in this codebase. These are execution layer concepts defined in specifications like ethereum/execution-specs, not consensus layer implementation code.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests transient storage rollback functionality (EIP-1153) from the Ethereum execution layer specification. The target workspace contains Prysm, an Ethereum consensus layer client. Transient storage operations (TSTORE/TLOAD) and their rollback semantics are execution layer concerns not implemented in consensus layer code.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests snapshot stack synchronization between persistent and transient storage, which are execution layer state management concepts. The Prysm codebase is a consensus layer client that does not implement execution layer state snapshots or transient storage mechanisms.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests the get_account function from the execution layer state management specification, ensuring it never returns None. This is an execution layer API not present in Prysm's consensus layer implementation.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests set_account behavior with None parameter and storage preservation, which are execution layer state management primitives. Prysm implements consensus layer logic and does not contain these execution layer account manipulation functions.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests destroy_account atomicity, ensuring both account and storage trie removal (related to SELFDESTRUCT/EIP-6780). These are execution layer state management operations not implemented in the consensus layer Prysm client.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests destroy_storage double-deletion safety, an execution layer storage trie management concern. The consensus layer does not implement execution layer storage trie operations.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests mark_account_created persistence across reverts, affecting EIP-2200 gas accounting and EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT constraints. These are execution layer transaction lifecycle concerns not implemented in consensus layer code.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests get_storage default value behavior (returning U256(0) for unset keys), which is an execution layer storage read primitive. Prysm's consensus layer does not implement execution layer storage access functions.

SPECIFICATION-ONLY: This checklist item tests set_storage precondition (account existence assertion) to prevent orphaned storage tries. This is an execution layer state mutation primitive not present in the consensus layer Prysm implementation.
